question: P, Q, R, S, T and U each have exam on different days of the week starting from Monday and ending on Saturday of the same week. R has exam on Tuesday. Only one student has exam between P and R. Q has exam on the day immediately after P. None of them has exam before U, and S has exam on the day immediately after R. T has exam on which day?
